privacy.title: Privacy policy – Photocells
privacy.desc: What Photocells does with your data: camera frames never leave the device, no account, no ads, no tracking.
privacy.body:
Short version: Photocells has no account, no ads and no tracking. The camera image never leaves your phone.

Camera

Photocells uses the camera to detect when someone crosses the line. Frames are analysed in memory on your device. To let you check each crossing, the app keeps the frame of each crossing in memory while the session and its summary are open, and discards it when you leave them. No photo or video is saved to your device, your history or iCloud, or sent anywhere.

Sessions and our server

To synchronise the phones of a session, Photocells uses our server (photocellsapp.com). It stores what a session needs to work: its type, the distances you enter, the participating devices and the crossing times. Devices are identified with a random token created by the app; it is not linked to your name, email, Apple Account or Google account. Data travels encrypted (HTTPS/WSS). You can ask us to delete the sessions of your device by writing to dpappssupport@gmail.com.

Athletes and comments

The athlete names and comments you add to a session are stored only on your device. They are never sent to our server. On iPhone, your history is copied to your private iCloud database (Apple's iCloud, under your account) so it is available on your other devices and after a reinstall; you can turn this off in iOS Settings → your name → iCloud. On Android, it is included in your phone's backup if you have backups enabled.

Purchases

Subscriptions are processed by Apple (App Store) or Google (Google Play). We don't receive your payment details; the app only checks whether a subscription is active.

What we don't do

No analytics or advertising SDKs, no tracking across apps or websites, no location, no contacts, no sale of data.

Children

Photocells is a general-audience sports tool and does not knowingly collect personal data from children.

Contact

Diego Prados, independent developer · dpappssupport@gmail.com. Last updated: 11 November 2026.

support.title: Support – Photocells
support.desc: Help with Photocells: setting up the camera, sessions with several phones, subscriptions and restoring purchases.
support.body:
Can't find your answer? Write to dpappssupport@gmail.com. A real person replies.

Getting good times

Where should I put the phone?

At the side of the lane, at hip height if possible, pointing across the track. Line up the red line with the crossing. Keep the background still (avoid trees moving in the wind or passing traffic right behind the line).

Sun and shade

Exposure is locked when the session starts. Avoid placing the line where the light changes a lot (from strong sun to deep shade). Before the athlete starts, check that the indicator at the top of the session shows DETECTOR ON in green.

A crossing was missed or an extra one appeared

Open the session settings and use "Discard last crossing" for an extra one. Check that the phone is stable and the detector indicator is green (DETECTOR ON) before the athlete arrives.

Sessions

How do several phones work together?

Create a session on one phone and share the 4-digit code. The others tap JOIN, enter the code and choose their position. Times are synchronised through our server, so every phone needs an internet connection.

Athletes and comments

Add athletes when you create a session or later from its summary, separated by commas. In History, tap an athlete to see only their sessions. This information stays on your devices.

Subscription

What is free?

Joining a session is free. Creating sessions requires Photocells Pro (7-day free trial, then monthly or yearly).

Restore a purchase

Open Settings in the app and tap Restore, signed in with the same Apple Account or Google account you used to subscribe.

Manage or cancel

iPhone: Settings app → your name → Subscriptions. Android: Google Play → Profile → Payments and subscriptions → Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before renewal.

terms.title: Terms of use – Photocells
terms.desc: Terms of use of the Photocells app and the Photocells Pro subscription.
terms.body:
By using Photocells you agree to these terms. On iPhone, Apple's Standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement also applies.

The service

Photocells measures times with the device camera and synchronises sessions through our server. Times depend on the device, its position, the light and the scene; they are meant for training and are not certified for official competition. We try to keep the service available but can't guarantee it will be uninterrupted.

Photocells Pro

Creating sessions requires an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account or Google Play account when you confirm the purchase (or when the trial ends). It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store or Google Play account settings. Refunds are handled by Apple or Google under their policies.

Acceptable use

Don't misuse the service, interfere with other users' sessions or try to access data that isn't yours.

Liability

The app is provided "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages or for decisions made from the measured times.

Changes and contact

We may update these terms; the current version is always on this page. Questions: dpappssupport@gmail.com. Last updated: 11 November 2026.
